svg.text: A little taco. A lot of personality.
Six original directions for a playful creation assistant. Each shown as a mark, wordmark and small app icon.

g.text: A soft little companion for making big things.
A taco reduced to two confident folded forms.
Just a shell and two eyes. Small, calm, curious.
An idea taking shape, with a leaf on top.
A pocket-sized taco from a world you built.
A cheeky wink, a bold outline, a little attitude.

svg.text: Best balance of cute, simple and recognizable.
Best if you want to keep the interface quieter.
Study cues: Linear + Raycast / economy; Discord / character; Claude / warmth. Original Takko shapes throughout.
